summary: Iteration 26: Verified (1) the /sign/:token employee counter-signing bug fix end-to-end in a real browser, and (2) the new chartered_accountant role (sidebar filtering + RoleGate direct-URL guards), plus admin regression. 8/8 backend pytest cases passed; all frontend checks passed. No functional defects found.
action_items: Doc drift only: /app/memory/test_credentials.md states ENFORCE_ADMIN_2FA=true, but /app/backend-nest/.env has ENFORCE_ADMIN_2FA=false, so admin login returns must_setup_2fa=false and lands directly on /dashboard (no /setup-2fa redirect). Align the doc or the env value.
critical_code_review_comments: RoleGate defaults role to 'admin' when user?.role is undefined (App.jsx L55) — if the user object ever loads late/partially this fails open to admin-level routes. Prefer defaulting to a non-privileged role or rendering nothing until auth resolves. Note the backend must remain the real authority; frontend RoleGate is UX-only.

SignLetter page footer says 'single-use link' but the token remains readable after signing (GET returns the doc with sign_status=agreed). Re-POST is correctly rejected, so this is cosmetic/informational only.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all sidebar, guard and sign-flow checks passed)
